security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, documentation examples, and local validation control flow. One archive-packaging risk is confirmed because the packager includes every file under the selected skill folder, and one semantic issue allows unintended output paths for new skills.

remediation.issue: The package script archives every regular file under the selected skill folder.
remediation.suggestion: Add exclusions for hidden files, environment files, keys, and symlink targets before writing the archive.

remediation.issue: The initializer accepts an unvalidated skill name from the command line.
remediation.suggestion: Reject absolute paths, path separators, and traversal segments, then verify the resolved target stays inside the output directory.

semantic_findings.title: Unvalidated Skill Name Path Traversal
semantic_findings.description: The initializer combines the requested output path with the user-provided skill name without enforcing the documented hyphen-case rule. Absolute names or traversal segments could create the skill outside the intended directory.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code directly assigns CLI input to skill_name and joins it to the base path without validation. The usage text documents naming rules, but the script does not enforce them.

content.value_statement: AI teams often struggle to turn repeated workflows into reliable reusable skills. This skill guides discovery, structure, resources, validation, and packaging for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Explains how to write SKILL.md frontmatter and body instructions.
Guides users through concrete examples before designing a skill.
Recommends scripts, references, and assets for reusable skill resources.
Provides Python scripts to initialize, validate, and package a skill folder.
Includes reference patterns for sequential workflows and output examples.
limitations: It does not create production-ready domain content without user-provided examples.
The helper scripts operate on local files and do not manage remote repositories.
Validation checks basic structure, not full security or quality.
Packaging includes files in the selected skill folder, so users must review contents.

use_cases.title: Build a New Skill
use_cases.description: Plan the skill purpose, folder structure, resource files, and first SKILL.md draft from real user tasks.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Workflows
use_cases.description: Turn repeated operational work into reusable skill guidance with scripts, references, and validation steps.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Skill for Sharing
use_cases.description: Validate frontmatter, remove placeholder resources, and package a completed skill for distribution.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new reusable skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to help me create a new skill for [task]. Ask only the key questions first.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Skill Resources
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning for scripts, references, and assets.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design reusable resources for [workflow]. Explain what belongs in scripts, references, and assets.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Existing Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of an existing skill folder.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my existing skill at [path]. Identify missing trigger details, bloated instructions, and validation gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare for Distribution
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced release preparation before sharing a skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to validate and package the skill at [path]. Report blockers, included files, and cleanup needed before sharing.

output_examples.input: I need a skill for recurring invoice analysis.
output_examples.output: A focused discovery plan, a proposed skill structure, and recommended reusable resources for invoice workflows.

output_examples.input: Review my existing skill before I share it.
output_examples.output: A readiness summary covering trigger clarity, resource organization, validation status, and files that need cleanup.

output_examples.input: Help my team turn a manual release checklist into a skill.
output_examples.output: A workflow-based skill outline with sequential steps, validation points, and resource recommendations for repeatable releases.

best_practices: Start from real user requests before writing instructions.
Keep SKILL.md concise and move detailed references to resource files.
Run validation and remove placeholder files before packaging.
anti_patterns: Do not include broad background material that the model already knows.
Do not keep unused generated resources in the final skill folder.
Do not package folders before checking for private or unrelated files.

faq.question: What does this skill help me create?
faq.answer: It helps create or update AI skills that package workflows, instructions, scripts, references, and assets.

faq.question: Does it write a complete skill automatically?
faq.answer: It guides the process, but useful skills still need clear examples and domain details from the user.

faq.question: Can it validate a skill folder?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a quick validation script for frontmatter, naming, and basic SKILL.md requirements.

faq.question: Can it package a skill for distribution?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a packaging script that creates a distributable skill archive after validation passes.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What should I review before packaging?
faq.answer: Review trigger text, remove placeholders, test scripts, and confirm the folder contains no private files.
